text: AI is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can create art, music, and even writing that looks or sounds like human work. For example, some programs can paint pictures, compose songs, or write short stories in seconds. However, there is an important difference between human and machine creativity. Humans create from emotions, experiences, and imagination. AI, on the other hand, learns from data and patterns. It does not truly feel or understand what it makes. So, while AI can support and inspire artists, human creativity remains special and deeply personal.
